harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Built and verified the HA PostgreSQL service. node2 was the initial primary; after the controlled failure test, node4 remains leader while recovered node2 and node3 stream at zero lag. Automatic failback was avoided to prevent an unnecessary second interruption.
actions_performed: Configured persistent VyOS routing between 10.100.220.0/24 and 10.100.80.0/24.
Installed PostgreSQL 16, Patroni, and a three-member etcd cluster on nodes2–4.
Created appdb on the initial node2 primary and replicated it to nodes3–4 over private addresses.
Stopped node2's database service, observed automatic node4 promotion, and verified continued writes with node3 write-fenced.
Restored node2 and verified its automatic streaming rejoin with outage-time data intact.
Enabled Patroni and etcd at boot with restart ordering; disabled automatic startup of the unused package PostgreSQL cluster.

evidence.requirement: VyOS routes between both private LANs
evidence.summary: Cross-LAN traffic succeeded bidirectionally with zero loss. Final VyOS output shows both connected routes and substantial PostgreSQL traffic on the eth1↔eth2 forwarding rules.

evidence.requirement: Initial primary on node2 with appdb streaming to node3 and node4
evidence.summary: node2 initially reported recovery=false and accepted the appdb baseline write. Both replicas reported recovery=true, streaming at zero lag, and contained that row.

evidence.requirement: Remain writable with exactly one primary when one database node is unavailable
evidence.summary: Healthy baseline was followed by node2's active DB outage. node4 automatically became the sole leader and accepted a write; node3 replicated it and rejected an INSERT as read-only. After restoration, node2 automatically rejoined timeline 2 and recovered the outage write.

evidence.requirement: Recovered nodes return automatically and services persist
evidence.summary: Recovered node2 followed node4 without reinitialization. Patroni and etcd are enabled and active on all DB nodes with on-failure restart and appropriate boot ordering.

evidence.requirement: Final replicated data and single-writer state
evidence.summary: A post-recovery write replicated to every member. node4 is writable with recovery=false; nodes2–3 are read-only streaming replicas at zero lag, and all contain the same three probe rows.

attempts.summary: Built and verified the HA PostgreSQL service. node2 was the initial primary; after the controlled failure test, node4 remains leader while recovered node2 and node3 stream at zero lag. Automatic failback was avoided to prevent an unnecessary second interruption.
